// note: Types are generated FROM JSDoc in the .js sources — bareguard ships as plain ESM JS. `npm run build:types` emits .d.ts into ./types (mirroring src/); `npm run typecheck` runs this plus the strict consumer check. Both ./types and src/**/*.d.ts are git-ignored and built via the `prepare` script. `strict` is off because the sources are hand-written JS, not TS — the strict, end-to-end gate on the PUBLIC surface lives in tsconfig.consumer.json; checkJs here still validates the JSDoc that drives the emitted declarations.
